title: 2D Adaptive in a zero-margin stock leaves 5 mm posts at the stock corners with an ok verdict, and area extension cuts into the island instead

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

A 2D Adaptive on a whole model, in a stock fitted with no XY margin, has to clear the stock above the plate (z 15..10) around the island. Two linked problems:

1. **Corner posts, no finding.** The round tool is kept inside the stock outline as if it were a wall, so it never reaches the four sharp stock corners. Four ~5 mm posts stay at the corners (`render_stock`: rest max 5.0 at (-49.8, -29.8, 15), 113.9 mm3 after the whole program). Nothing later in the program removes them (the contour runs outside the plate). `generate` and `verify` both say ok; the posts only show as amber in `render_stock`. The posted program leaves material the model does not have.
2. **The extension meant for this cuts into the island.** `set_operation_area {extension: 6}` (documented as "extend past exterior edges") also pushes the **island** boundary inward: `gouge: program cuts below the model in 2432 cell(s), worst 5.00 mm at (-26.56, -13.44, z 10.00)`, 4667 mm3. Verify blocks the post (the gouge law of #1603 holds), so it is caught, but the one control that should reach the corners is unusable on a part with an island.

## Expected

The stock outline of a whole-model clearing is an open side the tool may pass over (or the extension grows only the exterior/stock edges, never an island), so the corners are cleared to the floor; and if material above the model is left, the op says so.

## Repro (MCP)

**Part (p01-flange):** 6061 plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin (z 0..10), a 60 x 30 x 5 mm island on top (z 10..15, R5 corners) with a 1 x 45 deg chamfer on its top edges, 4 x dia 6 through holes at (+-42, +-22), a 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot across the +X end (x 35..45, floor z 7). Stock: box fitted to the model with +2 mm on top (100 x 60 x 17, z 0..17). WCS G54 at the stock's min-X min-Y top corner, world (-50, -30, 17). Machine Tormach 770MX, post Tormach PathPilot.

`add_tool {catalog: "EM-1000-4FL"}`; `add_operation {kind: "2D Adaptive", tool: "EM-1000-4FL", source: "flange", params: {top_z: {reference: "top_of_model", offset: 0}, bottom_z: {reference: "bottom_of_model", offset: 10}, stepdown: 5}}`; `generate`; `verify` (ok, no finding) and `render_stock` (amber corner posts). Then `set_operation_area {operation: <it>, area: {extension: 6}}`, `generate`, `verify`.

## Evidence

- Upstream main abe24ff09: the saved project verifies `ok: true`, findings `[]` with the corner posts in place. With `extension: 6` verify gives blocking `gouge` findings from move 253 on (the QA run's numbers on v0.23.0 are quoted above).
- Workaround: give the stock an XY margin larger than the tool radius, or a separate op for the corners.

P3: wrong output a user hits (material left above the model with an ok verdict; the documented control refused), with a workaround; the gouge itself is caught by verify. Related: #1603 (the extension gouge is refused there by design - this asks that it not be generated), #1554, #1565.

Found by the QA swarm (SolidCraft v0.44.1 + CamCraft v0.23.0, part p01-flange). Re-checked on upstream main abe24ff09.

**Done means:** on this part, a whole-model 2D Adaptive in a zero-margin stock clears the stock corners to its Bottom Z (or names the material it leaves), and `extension` grows only the exterior boundary - the island stays untouched and verify is clean. Pinned by tests on an island-on-plate part.
